title: IdeaForge troubleshooting isolation and conservative incident outcomes

source_commits.purpose: Bounded context, shared outcome classification, safe project incident paths and synthetic tests
Independent review corrections: mixed broken/crashing outcomes and diagnostic record byte cap
Identical indented JSON serialization for read/write byte limits

final_results_change: Documentation, default bounded budgets, this source-only receipt and direct UTF-8 byte writes to prevent Windows newline expansion.

changes.context: No recursive collection. Exact metadata schema projection from project.json and project_memory.json only; explicit current user facts, no raw source_text, arbitrary extra metadata or imported fact sources.
changes.exclusions: PDF/photo/OCR stores and versions, research summaries, fabrication/simulation plans, README, logs, incident reports, private staging and incidental filenames.
changes.containment: Canonical lexical path equality and project containment; linked path components and hardlinked metadata refused. ACTIVE and incident records bind to project identity and canonical root; contained legacy absolute pointers migrate.
changes.outcomes: Shared conservative classifier; anchored direct confirmation resolves, failures override positives, failures/explicit reopen transition resolved to open, uncertain reports preserve prior state.
changes.preservation: Original report never overwritten on follow-up; unique added reports and incident names, retained transition history and legacy resolution migration.

executed_checks.execution_setup_error: Rejected("Failed to create unified exec process: exec-server rejected request (-32603): helper_unknown_error: setup refresh had errors")
executed_checks.execution_error_origin: Execution setup failed before any local command; all runtime checks remain unrun.

source_verification.observation_caveat: Actions observations are snapshots, not a guarantee against a later external dispatch.

corrected_adverse_findings: Mixed success/current broken or crash could leave a resolved incident unchanged; classifier and chat-routing source tests expanded.
Diagnostic persistence lacked the same byte cap as follow-up persistence; diagnose now refuses before report write.
Compact JSON cap could permit larger indented records; all checks now share the exact persisted serialization.
independent_source_review.final_portability_correction: JSON persistence writes the exact encoded bytes rather than text with platform newline conversion.

regression_sources: Actual decorated diagnosis with intercepted provider requests and stubbed search; private marker and filename exclusion over two file orders, retained versions and multiple budgets.
Project separation, bounded Unicode/context/source handling, external/local-excluded symlink and hardlink aliases.
Conservative outcome matrix, persistence, fresh-process restart, project identity/root binding and legacy contained pointer migration.
Chat routing and reopening from resolved state for negated and mixed current failures; original and added report preservation.
Unique incidents and exact indented record/history budget refusals before replacing prior state.
limitations: All Python tests and compilation remain unrun; zero excluded-text requests is an intended tested invariant, not an executed result.
No claim of live provider/model, image processing, OCR, native PDF, hardware, firmware or performance validation.
Symlink/hardlink fixture tests may explicitly skip when a future filesystem cannot create those links; report future skips separately.
No guarantee against concurrent hostile filesystem path swaps.
Atomic JSON replacements do not make incident/ACTIVE a multi-file transaction; interrupted writes can leave unreferenced local outputs.
